title: Crystallized Entity Dossier Contract
purpose: Force the House ontology to operate on real entities across identity, scale, mission, decision systems, material capacity, history, relationships, reproduction/correction, visibility, longitudinal change, operators, outcomes, blind spots and research questions without turning project metaphors into factual labels.

relationships: typed outgoing/incoming relations with evidence where available
operators: only mechanisms evidenced by the dossier; each project operator must include why it fits and what would make it fail
fruit: documented outputs/outcomes plus omitted externalities or measurement limits
shadow: known unknowns, missingness, access limits, counterfactual difficulty and evidence gaps; never insinuation
tensions: documented or structurally plausible tensions phrased as questions unless directly evidenced
discovery_questions: questions whose answer would materially deepen or falsify the synthesis
scale_profile: operating_scale — what size of system is being observed
constituent_layers — person/team/organization/network/infrastructure or equivalent layers actually present
key_dependencies — external systems/resources without which the entity cannot perform its role
scope_boundary — what the dossier does not treat as part of the entity
reproduction_and_correction: reproduction_mechanisms — how mission, competence, rules or capability survive turnover
succession_or_training — how new people/units become able to perform the role
correction_channels — how error, failure or changed conditions can alter practice
exit_or_appeal — meaningful exit, appeal, review or replacement routes where applicable
observed_change — at least one dated example of adaptation, refoundation, migration or correction where available
visibility_and_access: public_observability — what a reader can inspect directly
restricted_or_confidential — what is legitimately non-public or aggregated
structural_missingness — why some desired information is absent
status_guard — what non-public status must not be inferred to mean
longitudinal_indicators: at least two dated observations for one or more relevant indicators where sources permit
each indicator names source IDs and an interpretation limit
change is descriptive; causal claims require separate evidence

evidence_labels.observed: Direct official/primary or high-quality empirical observation.
evidence_labels.synthesis: Project interpretation built from independently sourced observations.
evidence_labels.question: Open research question; not a claim.

operator_guard: Door, Garden, Shadow, Fruit, River, House, Forge, Tree, Swamp, Eye and other Potato operators are analytical labels over mechanisms. They must never replace the entity's legal identity or official purpose.
promotion_gate: At least three source-backed factual sections.
At least one material flow or dependency.
At least one explicit evidence gap.
At least one operator test with a failure condition.
At least one discovery question that cannot be answered by the entity's About page alone.
Scale and scope boundaries are explicit.
At least one longitudinal indicator or a documented reason longitudinal comparison is not yet possible.
